export const MAX_ADMISSIONS = 12; // R02
export const MAX_TRANSIENT_FAILURES = 2; // R02
export type Outcome = "ok" | "no_matches" | "transient_error" | "permanent_error" | "cancelled";
export type DenialReason = "turn_closed" | "invalid_call" | "in_flight" | "repeat_terminal" | "retry_exhausted" | "budget_exhausted";
export type Admission = { allowed: true; ticket: string } | { allowed: false; reason: DenialReason };
export interface Snapshot {
  turnId: string | null;
  revision: number;
  admissions: number;
  pending: number;
  closed: boolean;
}

const VALID_OUTCOMES: ReadonlySet<Outcome> = new Set<Outcome>([
  "ok",
  "no_matches",
  "transient_error",
  "permanent_error",
  "cancelled",
]);

const TERMINAL_OUTCOMES: ReadonlySet<Outcome> = new Set<Outcome>(["ok", "no_matches", "permanent_error"]);

// A signature binds a trimmed tool name to canonical JSON of its args plus the
// workspace revision at admission time (R02/R18).
interface SignatureRecord {
  revision: number;
  pending: boolean;
  terminal: boolean;
  failures: number;
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
}

// Canonicalize a value into a stable string form per R07.
function canonicalize(value: unknown, depth: number): string {
  if (depth > 100) throw new Error("max depth exceeded");
  const type = typeof value;
  if (value === null) return "null";
  if (value === undefined) throw new Error("undefined not allowed");
  if (type === "number") {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error("nonfinite number");
    // -0 equals 0 (R07).
    return value === 0 ? "0" : String(value);
  }
  if (type === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (type === "boolean") return value ? "true" : "false";
  if (type === "bigint" || type === "symbol" || type === "function") {
    throw new Error("unsupported type");
  }
  // array or plain object
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    const length = value.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, i)) {
        throw new Error("array hole");
      }
      parts.push(canonicalize(value[i], depth + 1));
    }
    // Reject extra own array properties (R07). The length property is ordinary.
    for (const key of Reflect.ownKeys(value)) {
      if (key === "length") continue;
      // Reject string keys that are not array indices and non-index extra props.
      if (typeof key === "string" && /^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(key)) {
        const idx = Number(key);
        if (idx >= 0 && idx < length && Number.isInteger(idx)) continue;
      }
      throw new Error("extra array property");
    }
    return "[" + parts.join(",") + "]";
  }
  if (isPlainObject(value)) {
    // Reject non-enumerable own properties and accessor properties (R07).
    const names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(value);
    for (const name of names) {
      const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, name);
      if (!desc) throw new Error("missing descriptor");
      if (!desc.enumerable) throw new Error("non-enumerable");
      if (desc.get !== undefined || desc.set !== undefined) throw new Error("accessor");
      // Symbol keys are not own string keys here; reject symbol keys explicitly.
    }
    const symbolKeys = Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(value);
    if (symbolKeys.length > 0) throw new Error("symbol keys");
    const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
    const parts = keys.map((k) => {
      const v = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, k);
      const val = v ? v.value : undefined;
      return JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonicalize(val, depth + 1);
    });
    return "{" + parts.join(",") + "}";
  }
  throw new Error("unsupported value");
}

// Validate and canonicalize arguments per R07. Returns the canonical string or
// throws on invalid input.
function signatureOf(tool: string, args: unknown): string {
  const name = typeof tool === "string" ? tool.trim() : "";
  if (name.length === 0) throw new Error("invalid tool name");
  if (!isPlainObject(args)) throw new Error("invalid args root");
  return name + "\0" + canonicalize(args, 0);
}

export class ToolLoopGuard {
  private turnId: string | null = null;
  private revision = 0;
  private admissions = 0;
  private pending = 0;
  private closed = true;
  private generation = 0;
  private ticketCounter = 0;
  private records: Map<string, SignatureRecord> = new Map();
  private tickets: Map<string, { generation: number; signature: string; outcome: Outcome | null }> = new Map();

  constructor() {}

  beginTurn(turnId: string): void {
    if (typeof turnId !== "string" || turnId.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new RangeError("turnId must be a nonempty string");
    }
    this.turnId = turnId.trim();
    this.generation++;
    this.revision = 0;
    this.admissions = 0;
    this.pending = 0;
    this.closed = false;
    this.records = new Map();
    this.tickets = new Map();
  }

  markWorkspaceChanged(revision: number): void {
    if (this.closed) throw new Error("no active turn");
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(revision) || revision < 0) {
      throw new RangeError("revision must be a nonnegative safe integer");
    }
    if (revision === this.revision) return;
    if (revision < this.revision) {
      throw new RangeError("revision cannot decrease");
    }
    this.revision = revision;
    // Pending duplicate protection is turn-wide, across revisions (R18). Records
    // stay but remain keyed by (signature, revision); advancing revision lets new
    // calls proceed while pending duplicates are still blocked via in_flight.
  }

  admit(tool: string, args: unknown): Admission {
    // Precedence: turn_closed, invalid_call, in_flight, repeat_terminal,
    // retry_exhausted, budget_exhausted.
    if (this.closed) return { allowed: false, reason: "turn_closed" };

    let signature: string;
    try {
      signature = signatureOf(tool, args);
    } catch {
      return { allowed: false, reason: "invalid_call" };
    }

    const rev = this.revision;
    const key = signature + "\0" + rev;
    let record = this.records.get(key);

    if (record && record.pending) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: "in_flight" };
    }
    if (record && record.terminal) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: "repeat_terminal" };
    }
    if (record && record.failures >= MAX_TRANSIENT_FAILURES) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: "retry_exhausted" };
    }
    if (this.admissions >= MAX_ADMISSIONS) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: "budget_exhausted" };
    }

    if (!record) {
      record = { revision: rev, pending: true, terminal: false, failures: 0 };
      this.records.set(key, record);
    } else {
      // Not pending, not terminal, failures < max: re-admit.
      record.pending = true;
    }
    this.admissions++;
    this.pending++;
    const ticket = "t" + (this.generation + this.ticketCounter * 0x10000000);
    this.ticketCounter++;
    this.tickets.set(ticket, { generation: this.generation, signature: key, outcome: null });
    return { allowed: true, ticket };
  }

  complete(ticket: string, outcome: Outcome): void {
    if (typeof outcome !== "string" || !VALID_OUTCOMES.has(outcome as Outcome)) {
      throw new TypeError("invalid outcome");
    }
    const entry = this.tickets.get(ticket);
    if (!entry) return; // unknown, ignored
    if (entry.outcome !== null) return; // already completed, ignored
    if (entry.generation !== this.generation) return; // superseded generation, ignored

    entry.outcome = outcome;
    this.pending--;
    if (this.pending < 0) this.pending = 0;

    const record = this.records.get(entry.signature);
    if (record) {
      record.pending = false;
      if (TERMINAL_OUTCOMES.has(outcome)) {
        record.terminal = true;
      } else if (outcome === "transient_error") {
        record.failures++;
      }
      // cancelled: releases pending only; no terminal, no failure increment.
    }
  }

  snapshot(): Snapshot {
    return {
      turnId: this.turnId,
      revision: this.revision,
      admissions: this.admissions,
      pending: this.pending,
      closed: this.closed,
    };
  }
}
